issue_context.title: `util.styleText` is not respecting `NO_COLOR` when first argument is an array.
issue_context.body:
### Version

v23.6.1

### Platform

```text
Windows 10
```

### Subsystem

_No response_

### What steps will reproduce the bug?

```console
$ NO_COLOR=1 node -p "JSON.stringify(util.styleText('red', 'red'))"
"red"

$ NO_COLOR=1 node -p "JSON.stringify(util.styleText(['red'], 'red'))"
"\u001b[31mred\u001b[39m"
```

### How often does it reproduce? Is there a required condition?

Always

### What is the expected behavior? Why is that the expected behavior?

The two commands above should print the same result.

### What do you see instead?

Different output.

### Additional information

Looking at the implementation.

When the first argument is an array, https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/309924f65d3cfa562a49fca8667f58fdea2759a6/lib/util.js#L132 didn't call `lazyUtilColors().shouldColorize`, but it's checked when the first argument is a string https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/309924f65d3cfa562a49fca8667f58fdea2759a6/lib/util.js#L138

review_comments: This would not validate the styles which is what I wanted to avoid
